units.source_text: 直到如今，岛村仍然把自己的绉纱拿去“雪晒”。

en.t: Even now, Shimamura still sends his own crepe fabric out to be snow-bleached.

units.source_text: 每年要把不知是谁穿过的估衣送去产地曝晒，虽说麻烦，

en.t: Each year it was troublesome to send secondhand clothing worn by someone unknown back to its place of origin to be bleached in the sun,

units.source_text: 但想到旧时姑娘们在冰天雪地里所花的心血，也还是希望能拿到纺织姑娘所在的地方，

en.t: yet when he thought of the care the young women of old had poured into it amid ice and snow, he still wanted it taken to the place where the weaving girls lived,

units.source_text: 用地道的曝晒法曝晒一番。

en.t: so it could be bleached once in the proper traditional way.

units.source_text: 晨曦泼晒在曝晒于厚雪上的白麻绉纱上面，不知是雪还是绉纱，染上了绮丽的红色。

en.t: Morning light poured over the white hemp crepe spread on the deep snow, and whether it was the snow or the crepe, it was dyed a lovely red.

units.source_text: 一想起这幅图景，就觉得好像夏日的污秽都被一扫而光，

en.t: Simply recalling that scene made him feel as though all the grime of summer had been swept away,

units.source_text: 自己也经过了曝晒似的，身心变得舒畅了。

en.t: as if he himself had been bleached clean, and his body and spirit grew light.

units.source_text: 不过，因为是交由东京的估衣铺去办，古老的曝晒法是否会流传至今，岛村就不得而知了。

en.t: However, since he left it to a secondhand-clothes shop in Tokyo, Shimamura had no way of knowing whether the old bleaching method had survived to the present day.
